post.description: Start a run on a goal, always detached (`capcomd run --detach <goal>` in the project's directory): returns at once with the new run, `state: "starting"`; the `daemon` and `prj-…` streams then announce it with `run.created` like a run started from the CLI. Needs the `steer` scope. `Idempotency-Key` is scoped to the calling client: same key + same body replays the first response (201, header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) without starting another run; same key + different body: 409 `idempotency_conflict`. Keys are kept 24 h; a request that failed (422, 500) is not recorded, so retrying it with the same key tries again. 422 `invalid` for a bad body, a `repo` that isn't a project checkout, no repository at all, or a run `capcomd run` itself refuses (unknown profile, no planner profile); `message` says which.

profile.description: Agent profile, as `capcomd run --profile`: the worker of the built-in recipe. Refused (422) when the run uses a planner agent, which picks its own workers.

get.description:
Lifecycle feed: only run and agent state changes (run.created, run.started, run.paused, run.resumed, run.completed, run.failed, run.cancelled, run.deleted, agent.spawned, agent.started, agent.paused, agent.resumed, agent.done, agent.failed, agent.cancelled, agent.reaped, approval.requested, approval.decided). Tool calls and messages are not here; they stay in step and thread events.
Each event carries a trusted `data.cause` code and the envelope's trusted `text`; `seq` is the source event's seq (a run.* event shares the seq of the agent event that caused it, sent right after it), so Last-Event-ID resume works the same.
Activity is not a state change, so it is not in this feed by default: a stream client opts in with `?activity=1` (Agent activity, below).

get.description:
Files the run's agents changed, with lines added and removed: `git diff --numstat` of each agent's latest work (the commit it pushed, else its latest checkpoint) against where its branch left the run's target branch. One row per (agent, file), sorted by path; `added`/`removed` are null for binary files. Paths are agent-written (x-untrusted).
`agentId` limits it to one agent; `limit` (default and max 500) caps the rows, and only the 100 agents with the newest work are diffed: `truncated` says rows were left out, `total` counts the rows before the cut.
Refetch when the run stream shows agent.checkpointed, agent.done, agent.failed, agent.paused or merge.succeeded with a seq above `asOf`. Work the daemon cannot read (no repository, a deleted branch) is a `sources[].error`, not an HTTP error.

post.description: Pause every pending or running agent of the run (no body). An agent that hasn't started is paused now (`changed`); a running one is asked to stop (`pending`): at its next check it stops, its work is committed and pushed to its branch, and it is paused. Confirmed by agent.paused per agent and run.paused once every live agent is paused. 409 `conflict` when no agent is pending or running. Needs the steer scope. `Idempotency-Key` (8-200 chars) is scoped to the calling client and kept 24h: same key + same request: 200 with the first result (replay); same key on a different request (another route, run, agent or body): 409 `idempotency_conflict`. Errors: 404 `not_found` (unknown run or agent), 409 `conflict` (state), 422 `invalid`.

post.description: Run every paused agent of the run again now (no body): paused here, with `capcomd pause`, or by a provider usage limit (that login's recorded limit is cleared). Each continues from its work on its branch as its next attempt. Confirmed by agent.resumed per agent and run.resumed. 409 `conflict` when no agent is paused. Needs the steer scope. `Idempotency-Key` (8-200 chars) is scoped to the calling client and kept 24h: same key + same request: 200 with the first result (replay); same key on a different request (another route, run, agent or body): 409 `idempotency_conflict`. Errors: 404 `not_found` (unknown run or agent), 409 `conflict` (state), 422 `invalid`.

get.description:
SSE. Each event frame: `id: <seq>`, `event: <type>`, `data: <envelope JSON>`. Resume by sending `Last-Event-ID: <seq>`.
If that seq was compacted away, or this client's buffer overflowed (slow reader), the server sends `event: stream.reset` with {snapshotSeq, reason},
then `snapshot.*` frames ending with `snapshot.end`, then live events from snapshotSeq+1. Handle both reasons the same way: drop local state, apply the snapshot.
A `: heartbeat` comment every 15s; treat ~45s of silence as a dead socket. There is no global stream: subscribe to `daemon` and open a run stream on drill-in.
The SSE `event:` field is the frame type: the envelope's dotted `type` for events, else `stream.reset` or `snapshot.*`.
Run scopes accept `?feed=lifecycle`: no snapshot.steps/threads, only lifecycle events (below) after the snapshot, and `?activity=1`: live, ephemeral agent.activity_changed frames (at most one per agent per second), and `?thread=1`: live, ephemeral agent.thread_item_changed frames (Agent threads, below).
Timestamps (ts, decidedAt, expiresAt): RFC 3339 UTC with exactly 3 millisecond digits, e.g. 2026-10-25T07:57:00.000Z.

anyOf.description: Remote media never loads by itself; attachment, inline and workspace media load through the daemon only

text.description: Agent-written text: the trailing block still being written. Plain text: never markdown, HTML, or a link to follow

anyOf.description: Reserved for token streaming: the last block of an open say/thinking item, as plain text. Not emitted yet

text.description: Agent-written text: text run. Plain text: never markdown, HTML, or a link to follow
Agent-written text: inline code. Plain text: never markdown, HTML, or a link to follow
Agent-written text: the link's text. Plain text: never markdown, HTML, or a link to follow

href.description: Agent-written text: where it points, for display (credentials removed); null for target none. Plain text: never markdown, HTML, or a link to follow

target.description: Classified by the daemon. web: http(s) only; artifact: an attachment the daemon holds (id); file: a path in the agent's workspace (path); agent / run: a capcomd id (id); none: anything else (javascript:, data:, mailto:, custom schemes, paths outside the workspace): show `text` as plain text

host.description: Agent-written text: web: the URL's host, show it next to the text. Plain text: never markdown, HTML, or a link to follow

id.description: artifact: attachment id (att-…); agent: agt-…; run: run-…

path.description: Agent-written text: file: relative to the workspace root, '/'-separated, normalized (never ..). Plain text: never markdown, HTML, or a link to follow

mismatch.description: The text looks like a URL or host other than where the link goes: show the real destination (host, or the full URL)

path.description: Agent-written text: file in the agent's workspace, relative and normalized: GET /v1/runs/{runId}/agents/{agentId}/workspace?path=. Plain text: never markdown, HTML, or a link to follow

attachmentId.description: att-…: an image a tool returned, stored by the daemon (png, jpeg, gif, webp only)

url.description: Agent-written text: http(s) URL, credentials removed. The daemon never fetches it; load it only on an explicit click. Plain text: never markdown, HTML, or a link to follow

host.description: Agent-written text: the URL's host. Plain text: never markdown, HTML, or a link to follow

checked.description: Task list item: done or not; null for a plain item
